en: Dependent on a non-fettered state, a non-fettered state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a non-fettered state, a non-non-fettered state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a non-fettered state, both non-fettered and non-non-fettered states arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is not bound (nanogantha), a state that is not bound arises by way of root-condition (hetupaccaya).
Dependent on a state that is not bound, a state that is bound (nogantha) arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is not bound, states that are both bound and not bound arise by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is both unbound and not unbound, a state that is unbound arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is both unbound and not unbound, a state that is not unbound arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is both unbound and not unbound, states that are both unbound and not unbound arise.
Nine in the case of root; ... pe ... one in the case of resultant; ... pe ... nine in the case of non-disappearance. (Nine in all cases.)
